title: Unit 19 Consolidation: Landscape, Belonging & Regional Character

sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can navigate spatial postpositions (innen, túl, szerte, mentén, táján, végig) with confidence
I can apply directional vertical metaphors (fel a fővárosba, le vidékre) accurately in discourse
I can correctly assign superessive and inessive cases to Hungarian regions and cultural landscapes
I can synthesize geography, communal identity, and literary sociography in advanced writing
